spec.text: Edit image 1. Keep EVERYTHING in image 1 exactly the same: the composition, the room, the window and Taipei 101, the lighting, her pose, her hands, her hair and her clothes. Change ONLY her face so it matches the face reference sheet in image 2: large round dark-brown eyes with white catchlight highlights, short soft brown eyebrows, a small button nose, round full cheeks with soft pink blush and a small closed-mouth smile, in the same matte clay style.
